_comment: Case pack for CASE 001 / OPERATION SHADE, transcribed verbatim from docs/evidence/case-001-operation-shade.txt. Every field traces to an E-0x exhibit so the UI can cite its source on screen — 'use of the evidence' is an explicit judging criterion. Schema is deliberately case-agnostic: case-002-sofia.json and case-003-aditi.json use the same keys.

case.logline: A single creator. Four thousand eight hundred messages a month. One person answering them.
case.mission: Find what is making Maya harder to scale. Build what gets her out of the loop, without making her audience feel like they are talking to a machine.
case.ask: Build one working product that gets Maya out of the reply loop without making her audience feel handed to a machine.
judged_on: Value to a real audience member
case.final_line_template: Maya no longer needs to ____ because ____.

creator.name: Maya Rao
creator.reputation: Maya is not famous-famous. She is trusted. Her audience follows her because she is specific, honest and willing to say what is not worth buying.
creator.assessment: The asset is the judgement, not the follower count.

voice._source: E-06.1 voice note (00:52) + E-07 seized items
voice.voice_note: I genuinely do not want to stop talking to my audience. That is the best part. I just do not want to answer the same question 400 times. People follow me because they trust my taste. I want them to feel like they are still getting my recommendation, even when I am not personally typing the answer.
read_between_the_lines: She is not asking for less relationship.
The audience wants judgement, not a catalogue.
The product has to preserve trust.
voice.creed: People do not need more products. They need confidence.
style_rules: Willing to say a product is not worth the money.
Asks what you already own before adding anything.
Calls her favourite moisturiser 'the good one' — and her audience has started calling it that too.

decision_rules._source: E-02.2, the routing she already does in her head

then: ask what foundation they currently wear

intake_questions: What do you hate about it?
Do you actually care about skincare or do you just want to look hot tomorrow?
decision_rules.margin_note: Need to turn all this into something people can use without me answering 200 questions a day.
decision_rules.hard_rule: DO NOT RECOMMEND RETINOL TO EVERYONE

shelf.maya_note: Beautiful, but too much for me.

shelf_assessment: Maya is not a database. Her value is the judgement layered on top of the product. The subjective layer is not noise — it is the product.

movement_report.observation: The visible audience and the valuable audience are not the same thing.

intelligence_drop_1600.headline: THE CUSTOMERS WHO DM MAYA ARE NOT HER BEST BUYERS
intelligence_drop_1600.detail: Her highest-value customers are more likely to save, privately share and return later. Many never message her at all.
intelligence_drop_1600.the_question: The problem may not be 'How do we answer more DMs?' It may be: how do we help someone make a confident decision before they ever need to ask Maya?

hidden_audience.the_pattern: Every buyer sent 0-1 DMs and saved 5+. Every non-buyer sent 1-4 DMs and saved 1-3. The loud ones do not buy.
